title: 2023: quantum collapse is a relaxation of the temporal flow

statements.text: Quantum collapse is a physical relaxation process with a local rate built from invariants of the temporal flow, giving a covariant, non-signaling Lindblad dynamics with quantitative predictions for interferometers, superconducting circuits and optomechanical resonators.

sources.quote: Collapse is treated as a relaxation process driven by invariants of temporal flow rather than as an axiom or external postulate.
